notation.visual_grounds: Open double-lobed epsilon-like capital plus low n; no squared stem. Retain the alphabet doubt at its first page occurrence.
Two separate near-horizontal strokes in revenir au =; no letter humps. Context suggests même, but the transcription preserves the sign.
Detached top roof above a long G descender; marked only at this occurrence because the possible hat is local rather than a recurring separate alphabet.

A plain n and hyphen precede systèmes; no parentheses, minus one, or additional numeral occur.

notes: Page evidence: author number 25 is at the top centre; archival pencil number 170 is at bottom left. No title or date appears. The sheet is wholly handwritten in the authorial text hand apart from the archive number.

The first paragraph proposes the name spéciale or n-galoisienne for an n-category described through locally constant (n−1)-champs, then proposes an equivalent n-functor description and related fundamental-groupoid / geometric-realization terminology.

The second paragraph proposes recovering G_n through an exactness condition on n-functors out of the category. It explicitly refers to finite and arbitrary limits and then to the difficulty of n-limits in n-categories.

The manuscript is tentative in its own words: ce qui doit revenir au =; doit s’interpréter; on a envie de dire. The page ends mid-sentence at Il est prudent dans tout. These are transcribed proposals, not proved statements.

No proof was attempted. No assertion of equivalence, existence, or reconstruction has been mathematically established by this reading. Ink-level formula parsing and symbol comparisons are not counted as proof checks.

Math-triggered inspection: the weak first lim sign was cropped because changing an arrow to an underline changes the notation. The inverse-limit reading remains uncertain even though the paired finite/arbitrary formulation suggests it. The second lim has a clear right arrow.

Math-triggered inspection: the outer closing delimiter of Hom looked bracket-like in the half. Its crop shows a curved tall parenthesis without a top horizontal bar; both witnesses’ parentheses are retained.
The manuscript visibly says n-systèmes. There is no ink basis for changing the index to n−1. The editorial comparison to another text in H is not imported into this page.
The crowded l in la catégorie was cropped to check for an omitted correction. Its retraced loop does not yield a separately readable cancelled word; la is retained without inventing a deletion.

Opening dira, literal =, correspondent, commutent, and engrenage were read in the ink. C’s remaining alphabet / cancelled-symbol / live-G / preposition / weak-arrow doubts are explicitly retained rather than silently normalized.

The whole image and each full-resolution half were viewed exactly once in the prescribed order. Each saved crop was viewed exactly once. No OCR, PDF text layer, other page, or other reader return was consulted.
